DuplicatesScreen.description: Of every work, its likeliest pair of every other site: every field the sites share is compared, the text itself aside — the title, the description, the tags, universes, characters, pairings, the status and other values, the size. First the pairs where the larger of the two works' scores by the formula times the chance the pair is one work is higher. "One work" links them as the work's window does: the grade and the interest become shared. "Different" — the pair is offered no more. The answers teach the model of the chance.
DuplicatesScreen.learntHint: The chance of one work is a model fitted on your answers "one work" and "different"; fitted again a few seconds after an answer
DuplicatesScreen.neverSearched: The pairs were never looked for yet. Press "Search again".
DuplicatesScreen.notLearntHint: No pair is marked "one work" yet: in place of the chance, the mean likeness of the shared layers
DuplicatesScreen.searchHint: Compare every work of every site anew, by the vectors of their titles and descriptions as they are now. In the background, in the queue of the computations; the answers are kept
DuplicatesScreen.title: Duplicates across the sites
PairRow.chanceHint: The chance this is one work: by the model of your answers (before the first "one work", the mean likeness of the layers)
PairRow.differentHint: These are different works: a link, if any, is taken away, the pair is offered no more
PairRow.facetsHint: How alike the two works' values of this facet are; a rare value weighs more than a common one. How much the facet tells of one work, the model learns from your answers
PairRow.priorityHint: The larger of the two works' scores by the formula times the chance of one work: what the pairs are ordered by
PairRow.sameAuthorHint: An author of one work goes by the same name as an author of the other
PairRow.sameHint: This is one work: link them as the work's window does; the grade and the interest become shared
PairRow.sizeHint: How alike the size is: the smaller over the larger in words and parts, their mean
PairRow.title: titles {{value}}
PairRow.translationHint: One is the translation of the other: different works of one text, each its own grade and interest; the pair is offered no more, and the model learns from it as from one work
PairRow.unanswerHint: Take the answer back: the link, "translation" or "different" goes, the pair returns to the unanswered
